vocabularies.note: Closed sets used across the program catalog. Agents indexing or filtering should treat these as the authoritative value space for the named fields.

programs.name: Restauro facciata Chiesa di San Niccolò Oltrarno
programs.description: Full stone restoration of the 13th-century facade of San Niccolò Oltrarno, including consolidation of the pietra forte cladding, replacement of failed iron tie rods, and conservation of the surviving portal sculpture. Project supervised by the Soprintendenza Archeologia Belle Arti e Paesaggio per la città metropolitana di Firenze.

programs.name: Conservazione affreschi Cappella Martelli
programs.description: Conservation treatment of the Filippo Lippi school fresco cycle in the Cappella Martelli, San Lorenzo. Treatment includes salt extraction, consolidation of detached intonaco, and reintegration of lacunae using reversible techniques per current Opificio delle Pietre Dure protocols.

programs.name: Borse di formazione per giovani restauratori
programs.description: Annual scholarship program funding four placements per cohort for graduates of Italian restoration schools (Opificio delle Pietre Dure, Istituto Centrale per il Restauro, accredited equivalents) on active restoration sites coordinated by the foundation. Scholarships cover stipend, materials, and site supervision for a 12-month placement.
